prompt: Realistic handheld smartphone mockumentary video, vertical, filmed by a coworker in a modern beauty salon at night. Two real monkeys at a manicure table: Paco, a pale-faced capuchin in a black apron with a white towel on his shoulder, tired and deadpan, holding a cardboard shoebox full of crumpled receipts; and Lola, a small elegant female monkey with golden fur, black dress with white collar, pearl necklace, gold earrings and a black bow, sarcastic and sharp. Spanish from Spain dialogue, natural lip sync. Deadpan sarcastic humor, quiet salon ambience. The phone screen stays plain white. No music, no subtitles, no text on screen.
